question: Does the non-renderable VISION3 MTF plus diffuse-rms granularity source signature remain stock-discriminating under frozen graph-digitization perturbations and one missing colour layer?

comparison.feature: per-domain per-channel natural-log curve shape after subtracting the first common-grid value
comparison.distance: mean per-domain per-channel RMSE to each nominal BU3 stock profile
comparison.negative_control: cyclically relabel the exact joint predictions without refitting

forbidden: change a trace, common grid, perturbation, feature, control or gate after scoring
tune a classifier, distance weight, threshold or channel subset on these three stocks
treat deterministic digitization perturbations as independent rolls or confirmation data
infer PSF, NPS, microscopic structure, spatial placement, RGB colour response or photographic appearance
render photographs, alter the current product default or claim roll/process/scanner calibration

branch_rule.pass: Retain a robust manufacturer-source signature and continue only to independent measured real-film evidence.
branch_rule.fail: Close source-signature classification without metric, grid, perturbation or gate rescue and seek a different independent stock observation.

claim_ceiling: Same-source robustness of three first-party manufacturer graph profiles under deterministic trace perturbations and missing-channel controls; not independent real-film confirmation, calibration, rendering or product evidence.
